reasoning: This commit rewrote GHOrganization.getMembers() to use a paged iterator with a new PagedIterator subclass whose wrapUp(GHUser[] page) method is left empty. Previously, members were fully populated via root.getUser(shallow[index].getLogin()), which fetched a complete user object. The new paging implementation removed that population step and never substituted an equivalent (i.e., never called GHUser.wrap() to attach the 'root' reference so lazy population works). The fix commit directly adds `GHUser.wrap(users, root)` into this exact empty wrapUp method, confirming this is the origin of the bug.
